changes.name: release
changes.impact: Nothing is synced for it: the platform's record and the labels of its objects name the new release.

changes.name: kubernetes.nodeImage
changes.impact: Every machine of the platform cluster is replaced by Cluster API, the control plane first, then one node group and node at a time. The rows roll/… say per unit what stops serving meanwhile.

changes.name: cert-manager
changes.blocking: not supported by this release: a third-party chart moves only in an upgrade that changes no k3s, Kubernetes version or node image, and this one also changes kubernetes.nodeImage. First finish an upgrade to a release with this one's Kubernetes version (1.35.10), k3s (v1.35.10+k3s1) and node image (ubuntu-2604-k8s-1.35.10-20270101000000-000000000000), with that release's build, then start this one

changes.name: pc-platform
changes.impact: The Application moves to the new chart version. ArgoCD syncs only the Cluster API objects of the platform cluster that the new chart renders differently. Before any sync the run checks that no machine or bootstrap template is new and that the control plane is unchanged, and fails with unexpected_rollout otherwise: no machine is replaced.
